summary__en: Steal an Egg's Halloween event adds the Halloween Dimension, an event zone with its own eggs and pets, including the Divine Voidseer Pumpkin and the Secret Grave Cerberus. Part 1 (the Halloween Dimension) ran from 17 Oct 2026 15:00 UTC to 24 Oct 2026 14:00 UTC on the Roblox event page. Part 2 is listed from 24 Oct 2026 15:00 UTC to 25 Oct 2026 16:34 UTC. The Enchanted Forest zone is in our lists too. Event pets are marked limited.
source_note: Publish time from the Roblox games API (our update tracker); what the event adds is from the community wiki; release date 17 Oct 2026 from the Roblox event page (Ali, 2026-10-24); Part 1 and Part 2 times from the Roblox virtual-events API (2026-10-24)

summary__en: Part 2 of Steal an Egg's Halloween event ran from 24 Oct 2026 at 15:00 UTC to 25 Oct 2026 at 16:34 UTC on the Roblox event page. The preview said a sealed portal had appeared beyond the gates of the Abandoned Manor. The game published a new version at 14:28 UTC. The community wiki now lists a Zombified Halloween Egg with six Zombified pets, zombie versions of Halloween Dimension pets, topped by the Divine Zombified Bone Emperor. The wiki also renamed the Abomination Kong to Gorillastein.
source_note: Event window and preview from the Roblox virtual-events API; publish time from the Roblox games API (our update tracker); Part 2 pets and egg from the wiki pet data module

summary__en: Update 1 added the Cherry Blossom biome with eight new pets, from the Epic Crane up to the Divine Kitsune. It also added the Sakura Incubator, which you unlock by bringing a Crane to the old Sakura tree, and two mutations, Bloom and the much rarer Spirit Bloom. Every 30 minutes the Great Bloom event fills the biome with Sakura Crystal trees; their crystals charge the incubator. The update went live with an Admin Abuse event on 22 Aug 2026.
source_note: Release date and time from the Roblox virtual-events API (event start); what the update added is from the community wiki Updates page, in our own words

summary__en: Update 2 added Titan Temple, a new endgame biome with eight new pets, topped by the Divine Nightflame and the Eternal Gorilla King. It also added the Monster Egg to the Robux shop, with six monsters that can roll a rare Mecha version, and the Hungry Frog event: you carry eggs with parasites home and feed the parasites to the frog to earn Monster Chests.
source_note: Release date and time from the Roblox virtual-events API (event start); what the update added is from the community wiki Updates page, in our own words

summary__en: Update 3 added the Rift boss event. Every 30 minutes rifts open across the map; inside you fight the Overlord for Boss Tokens, which you spend in the Boss Shop, including on the new Fractured mutation for placed eggs. It also added Boss Mastery, a reward track for defeating bosses, and a lobby rift that takes three random animals in exchange for a Rift Egg. Three rotating Rift banners each hold five rift-only animals.
source_note: Release date and time from the Roblox virtual-events API (event start); what the update added is from the community wiki Updates page, in our own words

summary__en: Update 4 added the Angels & Demons biome. Each night it can turn into an Angels or a Demons version, each with eight new pets, including the Divine ArchAngel and World Burner, and a rare merged version with extra luck. It also added a hidden shrine in the biome, the Luminous Egg in place of the Monster Egg, a new treadmill and trail tier for more Speed, and a base upgrade that holds one more pet.
source_note: Release date and time from the Roblox virtual-events API (event start); what the update added is from the community wiki Updates page, in our own words

summary__en: Update 5 started the Dr. Scramble event. Every 30 minutes his drones invade the map; destroying them drops Samples, which you spend in the new Experiment Shop on the Scrambled mutation consumable, Experiment eggs and boosters. A hidden pet, Nibbles (Experiment #013), gives a secret mission that ends in a secret item.
source_note: Release date and time from the Roblox virtual-events API (event start); what the update added is from the community wiki Updates page, in our own words

summary__en: Update 6 replaced the Rift trade-in machine with Dr. Scramble's Laboratory: three new banners, 15 new pets, and a trade-in system that takes eggs directly. Pity now gives the top reward. It also added the paid Extinction Egg with six extinct animals and a rare Skeletal reroll, and Dr. Scramble's return in a mech every 30 minutes, with a 100-tier boss milestone that ends in an Eternal pet.
source_note: Release date and time from the Roblox virtual-events API (event start); what the update added is from the community wiki Updates page, in our own words

summary__en: Update 7 added the Enchanted Forest, the farthest biome so far, with new pets including the Divine Spirit World Guardian. Community lists say it also added Wisp quests that unlock the Enchanted Tree, a Butterfly Bloom event, the Enchanted mutation consumable and a hidden fusion machine. The developer has not posted patch notes for it on the wiki yet.
source_note: Release date and time from the Roblox virtual-events API (event start); what the update added is from community update lists (stealanegg.app/updates), in our own words, not from developer patch notes

summary__en: Update 8 added mounts: community lists say a Shooting Star turns one of your pets into a mount you can ride. It also added the Nitro Race, which gives Trophies, and the Nitro mutation. The developer has not posted patch notes for it on the wiki yet.
